services.title: NCS (Nerve Conduction Study)
services.text: A test to measure how well your nerves are working.

services.title: EMG (Electromyography)
services.text: A test of your muscles and the nerves that control them.

services.title: EEG (Electroencephalography)
services.text: A test that records the electrical activity of the brain.

items.name: Migraine
items.text: Often a severe one-sided headache, which may come with nausea or sensitivity to light.

items.name: Tension-type Headache
items.text: A pressing or tightening pain around the head, often related to stress or fatigue.

items.name: Cluster Headache
items.text: Repeated attacks of severe pain around one eye.

items.name: Ischemic Stroke
items.text: Stroke caused by a blocked blood supply to the brain.

items.name: Hemorrhagic Stroke
items.text: Stroke caused by bleeding in the brain.

items.name: TIA (Mini Stroke)
items.text: Temporary stroke-like symptoms that can be a warning of a major stroke.

items.name: Epilepsy / Seizures
items.text: Recurrent seizures caused by abnormal electrical activity in the brain.

items.name: Febrile Seizures
items.text: Seizures in children that occur during a fever.

items.name: Parkinson’s Disease
items.text: Tremor, stiffness and slowness of movement.

items.name: Essential Tremor
items.text: Shaking of the hands or other parts of the body.

items.name: Dystonia
items.text: Involuntary muscle contractions causing abnormal postures.

items.name: Peripheral Neuropathy
items.text: Numbness, tingling or burning in the hands and feet.

items.name: Carpal Tunnel Syndrome
items.text: Nerve compression at the wrist causing hand numbness and pain.

items.name: Bell’s Palsy
items.text: Sudden weakness on one side of the face.

items.name: Myasthenia Gravis
items.text: Muscle weakness that gets worse with activity.

items.name: Sciatica / Radiculopathy
items.text: Nerve pain travelling from the back down to the leg.

items.name: Vertigo / Dizziness
items.text: Feeling dizzy or as if the surroundings are spinning.

items.name: Dementia / Memory Loss
items.text: Decline in memory and thinking ability.

items.name: Multiple Sclerosis
items.text: A disease affecting the brain and spinal cord.

items.name: Sleep Disorders
items.text: Sleep problems related to the nervous system.

faqs.q: How do I book an appointment?
faqs.a: Fill in the form on the Appointment page or contact the clinic using the contact details.
A priority / online booking gives you a preferred appointment slot. Please see the Fees page for charges.

faqs.q: When is the online video consultation available?
faqs.a: Video consultations are held from 10:00 PM to 11:00 PM. The fee is PKR 3,000.

faqs.q: When and where are NCS / EMG / EEG tests done?
faqs.a: At the facility Monday–Friday, 11:00 AM–02:00 PM. In Hafizabad on Sunday, 07:00 PM–10:00 PM. The facility location will be added soon.

faqs.q: In which cities does the doctor see patients?
faqs.a: Sialkot (New Life Hospital), Sheikhupura and Hafizabad. See the Locations page for details.
